mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM material WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.name AS name, coalesce(b.quantity, 0) AS balance, coalesce(sum(sm.quantity), 0) AS movement_sum FROM material m LEFT JOIN stock_balance b ON b.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN stock_movement sm ON sm.material_id = m.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY m.id, m.name, b.quantity HAVING coalesce(b.quantity, 0) <> coalesce(sum(sm.quantity), 0) ORDER BY m.name
